title: Phuket and Phi Phi Party Escape
alt: Longtail boats below the limestone cliffs of Phi Phi island in Thailand
transport: Private sedan transfers with speedboat island crossings

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Two island nights on Phi Phi change this trip. You wake up with no traffic and swim before breakfast.
expert.tip: Pack a dry bag for the boat days and reef safe sunscreen. The pirate boat party is loud and brilliant, so keep the Phi Phi mornings free to recover on the sand.

summary: Six days around Phuket and Phi Phi for travellers who want beach days with music. Tiger Kingdom, the Yona floating club off Phuket, two nights on car free Phi Phi and a pirate boat party, with a last night back in Phuket.
included: Included: 5 nights in 3 hotels with daily breakfast; Tiger Kingdom big tiger ticket with private transfer; Yona floating beach club experience; Phi Phi pirate boat party sailing; 9 airport, pier and island transfers including speedboat crossings.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; drinks on board; lunches and dinners; water sports and personal expenses.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Phuket and Tiger Kingdom
day_titles.3: On to car free Phi Phi

hotel_by_day.5: Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Chao Fah

1: Arrival at Phuket International Airport and private sedan transfer to Chalong
Check in, then a private transfer out to Tiger Kingdom
Big tiger ticket with keepers alongside you in the enclosure
Evening free, with Rawai and Nai Harn beaches a short ride away
2: Breakfast at the resort, then private transfer to the Chalong pier
Boat out to Yona, a floating club moored in open water off Phuket
Pool deck, sun beds and music all afternoon, drinks payable on board
Back to shore by evening with the rest of the night free
3: Breakfast, check out and private transfer to the Phuket pier
Speedboat transfer across to Phi Phi, where there are no cars at all
Check in and spend the afternoon on the sand near Tonsai bay
Optional: snorkelling off the beach or the island pool party after dark
4: Breakfast, then board the Phi Phi pirate boat for the day
Swim stops, music on deck and limestone walls rising out of the sea
This party sailing is kept for guests staying on the island
Evening free along the Tonsai strip
5: Breakfast, check out and speedboat transfer back across to Phuket
Private transfer on to the Ramada Plaza for your last night
Afternoon free beside the pool or over at Patong beach
Optional: Bangla Road after dark or the Simon Cabaret show
6: Breakfast and an easy morning before check out
Private sedan transfer to Phuket International Airport

program.name: Tigers and a floating club
program.description: Two nights on the quiet south of Phuket with a close up tiger visit and an afternoon at the Yona club moored offshore.

activities.name: Tiger Kingdom Phuket
activities.description: Time inside the enclosure with the big tigers, keepers beside you throughout, with a private transfer each way.

activities.name: Yona Floating Beach Club
activities.description: A club moored in open water off Phuket with a pool deck, sun beds and music through the afternoon.

stops.name: Phi Phi Islands
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Walking distance from Tonsai bay on car free Phi Phi

program.name: Two nights on car free Phi Phi
program.description: Island time with no traffic, swimming straight off the beach and a pirate boat party that is kept for people staying on Phi Phi.

activities.name: Phi Phi Pirate Boat Party
activities.description: A full day sailing around the Phi Phi group with swim stops, music on deck and the limestone cliffs close enough to touch.

activities.name: Snorkelling off the Beach
activities.description: Clear shallows right off the sand near Tonsai, with gear for hire a few steps from the resort.

activities.name: Island Pool Party
activities.description: Phi Phi runs an Ibiza style pool party most nights in season. Easy to add on your free island afternoon.
